descriptors.title: Issue a commercial registration (establishment)
descriptors.text: Through the Saudi Business Center; the owner must not hold another active sole-proprietorship registration; fees paid by SADAD or card. After issuance, registration is automatic with the Ministry of Human Resources, ZATCA, GOSI, Saudi Post (national address) and the Chamber of Commerce.

cap_text.submit:sa01: submit the application for Issue a commercial registration (establishment)
cap_text.pay:sa01: pay the fee for Issue a commercial registration (establishment)

descriptors.title: Issuing a commercial license
descriptors.text: Electronic only. Attachments: photo of the shop front, lease contract, title deed or investment contract, sanitation contract (optional), safety equipment invoice or safety report from the Civil Defense, copy of the building permit. Issued together with the Civil Defense safety permit. 1 to 10 days; fees apply.

cap_text.submit:sa02: submit the application for Issuing a commercial license

descriptors.title: Issuing a fast-track commercial license
descriptors.text: Commercial license with a safety permit for some activities; log in as owner or establishment manager when linked to a commercial register. 1 to 10 days.

cap_text.submit:sa03: submit the application for Issuing a fast-track commercial license

descriptors.title: Renewing a commercial license
descriptors.text: Not possible if the commercial registration has expired. Needs the lease, deed or investment contract and a safety equipment certificate or accredited technical report.

cap_text.submit:sa04: submit the application for Renewing a commercial license

descriptors.title: Issuing a building permit
descriptors.text: Building or fencing permit applied for through an engineering office; permit details sent to the electricity and water companies, Civil Defense, the insurer and the real estate registry.

cap_text.submit:sa05: submit the application for Issuing a building permit

descriptors.title: Issuance of a building occupancy and compliance certificate
descriptors.text: The compliance certificate is valid three years and issued with the occupancy certificate; no municipal fees.

cap_text.submit:sa06: submit the application for Issuance of a building occupancy and compliance certificate

descriptors.title: Issuance of a health certificate for food workers
descriptors.text: For workers in food and public-health establishments (restaurants, barbershops, laundries). Medical examination at a Ministry of Health approved centre; valid one year. 4 to 10 days.

cap_text.submit:sa07: submit the application for Issuance of a health certificate for food workers
cap_text.pay:sa07: pay the fee for Issuance of a health certificate for food workers

descriptors.title: Renewal of a health certificate
descriptors.text: Verification of the business license and of the worker's profession, medical examination, health education programme if applicable.

cap_text.submit:sa08: submit the application for Renewal of a health certificate
cap_text.pay:sa08: pay the fee for Renewal of a health certificate

descriptors.title: Issuance of a seasonal health certificate
descriptors.text: Seasonal variant of the worker health certificate.

cap_text.submit:sa09: submit the application for Issuance of a seasonal health certificate

descriptors.title: Permit for 24-hour commercial activities
descriptors.text: Linked to the commercial license and cancelled with it; renewable when 30 days or fewer remain.

cap_text.submit:sa10: submit the application for Permit for 24-hour commercial activities

descriptors.title: Issuing a home delivery permit
descriptors.text: For licensed commercial entities.

cap_text.submit:sa11: submit the application for Issuing a home delivery permit

descriptors.title: Safety license (Salama portal)
descriptors.text: Requirements vary with the classification and size of the business; applications on the Salama portal.

cap_text.submit:sa12: submit the application for Safety license (Salama portal)
cap_text.retrieve:sa12: obtain the civil defense safety report

descriptors.title: VAT registration for businesses
descriptors.text: For companies with an economic activity subject to VAT; a VAT account number is assigned upon registration.

cap_text.submit:sa13: submit the application for VAT registration for businesses

descriptors.title: VAT registration for individuals
descriptors.text: Individuals engaged in economic activity; mandatory above SAR 375,000 of annual revenue, optional between 187,500 and 375,000. 5 working days.

cap_text.submit:sa14: submit the application for VAT registration for individuals

descriptors.title: VAT registration for a group
descriptors.text: Two or more legal persons registered as one VAT group. 3 working days.

cap_text.submit:sa15: submit the application for VAT registration for a group

descriptors.title: Zakat and income tax registration
descriptors.text: After registration with the Ministry of Commerce; the TIN is generated automatically when the commercial registration is issued.

cap_text.submit:sa16: submit the application for Zakat and income tax registration

descriptors.title: Verify VAT registration
descriptors.text: By VAT account number, commercial registration number or VAT certificate number; instant.

cap_text.submit:sa17: submit the application for Verify VAT registration

descriptors.title: Update VAT registration details
descriptors.text: Amendments to registration details including financial details, with supporting documents. 3 working days.

cap_text.submit:sa18: submit the application for Update VAT registration details

descriptors.title: Register a new establishment or branch in GOSI
descriptors.text: After registration the establishment can obtain the GOSI certificate proving its registration.

cap_text.submit:sa19: submit the application for Register a new establishment or branch in GOSI

descriptors.org: Ministry of Human Resources and Social Development
descriptors.title: Visa issuance for an establishment
descriptors.text: Valid commercial register (except activities that do not need one), existing establishment, wage-protection compliance, allowed activity; payment.

cap_text.submit:sa20: submit the application for Visa issuance for an establishment

descriptors.org: Ministry of Human Resources and Social Development
descriptors.title: Employee transfer from another employer
descriptors.text: Through Qiwa; valid commercial register; employment contract for each worker.

cap_text.submit:sa21: submit the application for Employee transfer from another employer

descriptors.title: Renewal of residence permit (Iqama)
descriptors.text: Through Absher or Muqeem; valid passport, fees paid, medical insurance; fines start three days after expiry.

cap_text.submit:sa22: submit the application for Renewal of residence permit (Iqama)
cap_text.pay:sa22: pay the fee for Renewal of residence permit (Iqama)

descriptors.title: Extension of an exit and re-entry visa
descriptors.text: Through Absher or Muqeem, including for residents outside the Kingdom.

cap_text.submit:sa23: submit the application for Extension of an exit and re-entry visa
cap_text.retrieve:sa23: obtain the extended exit reentry visa
cap_text.pay:sa23: pay the fee for Extension of an exit and re-entry visa

descriptors.title: Final exit visa
descriptors.text: The residence permit must be valid at least 30 days; the visa lasts at most 60 days.

cap_text.submit:sa24: submit the application for Final exit visa
cap_text.pay:sa24: pay the fee for Final exit visa

tools.desc: Submits a new company-formation filing to the MoC registry system and returns the intake reference number and current review status for the applicant's new business entity.
Generates the signed business establishment certificate for a newly registered company, returning the certificate PDF and its registry reference number from the MoC company database.
Charges the filing fee for a new business entity registration at the Commerce Ministry and returns the payment receipt reference and status.
Submits a new trade permit request to the Balady ministry's business registry and returns the tracking reference for the filed application.
Generates the trade permit certificate for a business premises after validating the applicant's registration and zoning data, returning the signed PDF permit document with its reference number.

Submits a new trade-permit request to the Balady e-services portal for a business premises, registering the applicant's shop details and activity type, and returns the application reference number with its current processing status.

Generates the expedited business permit certificate for a shop or company, processed through the Balady IT backend. Returns the signed permit document (PDF reference and permit number) at the end of the workflow.
Submits a renewal request for an existing trade permit via the Balady department's internal business-registry gateway, and returns the reference number and status of the filed case.
Regenerates a business trading permit for an existing establishment via the Balady portal and returns the signed renewal certificate with its expiry date and reference number.

Submits a new construction-authorization request to the Balady municipal e-services portal and returns the tracking reference for the filed case. Use it to lodge a fresh building-license dossier with the department, including applicant details, parcel data and attached drawings.

Generates the construction authorization certificate for a site once plan review and inspection sign-offs are complete, returning the signed permit document with its reference number. Internal name: BLD-CERT (Balady e-Permits).

Submits a new request through the Balady e-permit portal to obtain a final property use-readiness and regulatory-conformity clearance, and returns the application reference number and current review status.

Generates the final sign-off paper for a finished structure: fetches the inspection results, zoning-conformity flags and as-built plan references tied to a permit ID, then returns the completion permit PDF with its QR verification stamp. Internal dept. name: BLD-CLOSEOUT-SVC (Balady IT).
Submits a new food-handler medical clearance request for staff at food outlets, registering the applicant's details and returning a tracking reference number and the expected review status.

Generates the food handler clearance record for a staff member after the medical screening and hygiene course are verified in the Balady municipal system. Returns the signed PDF card with the worker's ID, validity date, and permit reference number.
Processes the payment of the fee for a food-handler sanitary clearance request at Balady. Returns the transaction receipt and status of the paid service.
Submits a new request to renew a food-establishment sanitary clearance through the Balady IT portal. Returns the request reference number, current status, and the expected inspection date.

Regenerates a valid food-handler medical clearance for staff at licensed establishments: submits the applicant's ID and lab screening results to the Balady portal and returns the renewed clearance PDF with its validity date.

Processes the payment for a food-handler medical clearance renewal at Balady's municipal health unit. Charges the applicable fee and returns the transaction receipt with reference number and payment status.

Submits a new request in the Balady municipal licensing queue for a seasonal sanitary clearance, returning the application reference number and current review status for the food-handler or facility permit tracker.

Generates the Balady seasonal public-health clearance letter for food-handling and retail establishments: validates the operator's inspection record and returns the signed PDF permit ready for download.
Submits a new request to the Balady municipal licensing system for extended-hours trading operations, returning a tracking ID and the current review status of the filing.

Generates the round-the-clock trading license for storefronts and businesses via Balady's municipal licensing workflow; returns the signed extended-hours authorization certificate with its reference number.

Submits a new request for home-delivery authorization through the Balady e-services gateway; accepts applicant ID, business premises details and delivery vehicle data, and returns a tracking reference number with the application status.

Generates the signed delivery authorization for a residential unit: pulls the applicant's property file and building inspection record from the Balady back-office, validates them, and returns the finalized release certificate as a PDF with its reference number.
Submits a new request or declaration to the Civil Defense Salama portal via the DGPC e-services gateway and returns the generated filing reference number and current review status.

Retrieves the fire-safety clearance certificate for a premises via the Salama portal, returning the issued certificate document for the applicant's site. Our IT team's internal name for it is "SafeClear-CD".

Submits a new indirect-tax enrollment request for a business entity, collecting company identifiers, activity codes and turnover estimates, and returns the request reference number with the expected processing timeline.
Registers an entity in the indirect-tax ledger and returns the TIN-linked certificate confirming the taxable-supplier status issued by the ZTCA digital desk.

Submits a new indirect-levy enrollment request for a sole trader or natural person via the ZTCA portal, returning the enrollment reference number and the assigned taxpayer status once the file is accepted.

Submits an individual's sales-tax enrolment request and returns the issued VAT certificate with its assigned tax number and effective date. Developed by the ZATCA digital services team for the taxpayer-onboarding workflow.

Submits a new group indirect-tax enrolment request for a consolidated taxpayer cluster, collecting the member entities and their primary business identifiers, and returns the batch reference number and onboarding status.
Submits a consolidated indirect-tax enrollment request for a corporate cluster under a single parent entity and returns the Tax Group Certificate issued at completion.

Submits a new taxpayer onboarding request to the ZTCA e-filing gateway and returns the assigned filer reference number and onboarding status. Pulls entity details, activity codes and fiscal period from the applicant's profile to generate the registration record.

Retrieves the final certificate issued by the ZTCA onboarding workflow for taxpayer enrollment, covering the Zakat base and personal income levy obligations, returning the issued registration certificate and its reference number.
Submits a taxpayer's VAT status check request to the ZTCA indirect-tax registry and returns the current registration record, including TRN, filing status, and effective date.

Checks a business's indirect-tax enrollment status and returns the official certificate confirming its active filer number and effective date, issued by the ZTCA finance systems team (Taxpayer Status Lookup).

Submits a change request to the VAT taxpayer master record, letting registered businesses amend their contact details, trading address, and bank account info, and returns a reference number with the processing status.

Modifies a taxpayer's VAT profile on file (business address, contact persons, bank account, authorized signatories) and returns the signed amendment confirmation certificate issued by the ZTCA Indirect Tax Records unit.

Submits a new employer-site onboarding request to the GOSI portal, creating a fresh worksite record under the parent company account, and returns the assigned site reference number and submission status.

Onboards a new employer site into the social-insurance system and returns the issued enrollment certificate. Use it to create a fresh worksite or subsidiary record so payroll contributions can be linked to it.

tools.org: Ministry of Human Resources and Social Development
tools.desc: Submits a new application for an establishment entry permit via the MoHRSD workforce portal and returns the tracking reference and current processing status.

tools.org: Ministry of Human Resources and Social Development
tools.desc: Generates the signed entry-permit letter for a foreign worker's establishment placement, returning the authorization PDF with reference number, validity dates, and issuing officer seal. Built on the HR-Permits workflow ("Work Entry Permit Generator").

tools.org: Ministry of Human Resources and Social Development
tools.desc: Submits a new inbound staff move request (HR file intake for incoming personnel from an external employer) and returns the generated case reference number with the intake status.

tools.org: Ministry of Human Resources and Social Development
tools.desc: Generates the staff move-in clearance certificate for MHRSD personnel, returning the signed confirmation issued once an incoming hire's prior-service and pension-record handover is complete.

Submits a fresh request on behalf of a resident to extend their stay credentials at the Jawazat, using the department's internal intake code. Returns a tracking reference, the case status, and the next required action or document list.

Fetches the final issued document from the Jawazat residency card extension workflow for a given applicant file, returning the stamped renewed resident card record (ID number, expiry date, and issuance status) for internal verification.
Settles the government fee for a residency card extension through the Passports Dept. e-gate; returns the payment receipt reference and the amount charged.
Submits a new request in the Jawazat case system to renew a temporary exit-and-return permit for a resident, then returns the generated case reference number and the current processing status.
Renews a traveler's temporary departure-and-return permit via the GDP Jawazat portal and returns the issued extension certificate (PDF) with its new validity date.
Settles the government fee for a re-entry permit renewal request via the Jawazat portal and returns the payment receipt reference and the amount charged.
Submits a new request to the Jawazat exit-permit desk for a departing traveler's clearance and returns the application reference number with its current processing status.

Generates the exit-clearance certificate for residents leaving the country, issued by the Jawazat IT unit after the departure permit is approved, and returns the stamped clearance PDF with its reference number.
Settles the fee for the outbound clearance permit via the passport directorate's payment gateway and returns the receipt reference and amount paid.

Auto-completes and submits the ThirdParty medical clearance paperwork for an existing staff member: pulls the applicant's record, fills the health-clearance form fields, attaches supporting files, and returns the submission receipt with a tracking ID.
Auto-fills and submits the resident-ID extension forms via the TP portal, then returns the filing receipt and reference number for tracking.
